lines.text: Would you like one? Oh, are we not allowed to smoke in here?
Hmm... I wonder what Aki is up to.
This place is unlike anywhere else I've been.
The inside of this place is so peaceful.
I'm gonna head out for a smoke.
How about a drink later? You, me, and Aki?
You're not going to stay here, are you? Didn't you say you had something to do?
All right then. I'm gonna kick my feet up and take it easy. If you need me, just holler.
Where are we staying again? Before that though, where can I get some beer around here?
Ahh, this air is so refreshing. The sky seems so real... hard to believe it's all fake.
I'm gonna take the day off.
Let's make the most of our time together and have a good time!
I feel like I'm walking on sunshine!
Interesting, my body feels so at ease.
That was great! Where did you get this?
Is this a reward for all my hard work?
Oh wow, you shouldn't have! Thanks.
What is all this? You didn't have to do this, honestly.
Hey, got time for a drink?
Having a reward will give me more motivation.
Let's show 'em what we're made of.
Oh, am I going too?
All right, tell me what to do.
Let's get started, shall we?
Coming.
Don't die on me!
Waddya say we finish this?
Can we... Do this?
So... like this, right?
Turned out better than I expected. Hehe.
Actually, it's not too bad.
Hey!
Finish them.
Right now!
Down they go!
Did we get them?
Next!
Argh.
Uh.
Ugh.
No... ugh... I need to move...!
Whew... well, now that that's over, how about a drink?
